instructionAudio.text: Where is the cat?
Where is the goat?
Which word says where?
The jam lives ___ the jar with the lid on.
Where is the ball?
Snow settled ___ the roof.
The stamp goes ___ the envelope, top right.
Where is the dog?
Roots grow ___ the soil.
The slippers sit ___ the bed, out of sight.
Where is the bear?
The sun dropped ___ the barn.
Hide ___ the curtain so no one sees you.
Where is the rabbit?
Park your bike ___ mine, side by side.
My desk is ___ the window, so I see the yard.
Which words say where?
Where is the cup?
The net hangs ___ the posts, one on each side.
I sat ___ Mum and Dad, one on each side.
Where is the tree?
The queue formed ___ the gate before opening time.
Stand ___ the mirror to see your costume.
Where is the bird?
The clock hangs ___ the door, too high to touch.
Stars shine far ___ the clouds.
Fish swim ___ the surface of the pond.
Write your name ___ the line at the bottom.

The plane flew … the town.
